# Animesh Singh

<div class="role-line">PhD Student · Computer Science and Engineering · IIT Hyderabad</div>

I work on **eBPF network functions**, **program analysis**, and **network function verification**. I am interested in understanding the behavior of deployed network programs and building practical techniques to analyze them.

[Explore my research](research.qmd){.btn .btn-primary} [Read the blog](blog.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-secondary}

:::

<span class="eyebrow">CURRENT FOCUS</span>

## Making network programs easier to understand and verify

- Analyzing eBPF bytecode
- Reconstructing network-processing behavior
- Reasoning about composed network functions

## Selected publication

::: {.paper-card}

**Yaksha-Prashna: Bridging the Semantic Gap in eBPF Bytecode Analysis and Diagnostics**

*ACM CoNEXT 2026*
